title: Farm ERP proposed command transport envelope
description: Design contract, not an implemented JCB endpoint. Each command also requires its strict command-specific payload validator; commands.json specifies the minimum semantic contracts. Actor and organisation are derived server-side.

farm_guid.description: Null is allowed only for a registered organisation-wide command; it never means unrestricted farm access.

payload.description: Validate against the registered command-specific payload contract; unknown payload fields are rejected by that validator. This envelope alone cannot authorise or validate business data.
